Established c. 1265 by a descendant of the Tibetan royal house (founder Bumdegon, 1253-1280 on the infobox); capital Dzongkar, the White Fortress. 1612-13: the Tsangpa ruler leads an expedition to Ngari (West Tibet) and subjugates Mangyül Gungthang.
1619: the Tsangpa end the fighting by incorporating the kingdom.
1619: Mangyül Gungthang is conquered by the Tsangpa.

wars.name: Tsangpa conquest of Mangyül Gungthang
wars.outcome: The Tsangpa ruler Karma Phuntsok Namgyal subjugates Gungthang in his western expedition of 1612-13 and incorporates it definitively in 1619; the Gungthang page dates its destruction to 1620.
